svg.title: F-07 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-07 Follow the planned trajectory. M01 No function: No control output while braking is needed; the vehicle does not slow (H-02). M02 Stops functioning: Control stops; same as no function (H-02, rated as M01). M03 Unrequested function: Drive command while the vehicle should be held (H-05). M04 Function stuck: Command frozen at a positive acceleration; as M05 (H-01, rated as M05). M05 Excessive function: Acceleration command above the planned value (H-01). M06 Partial function: Braking command below the planned value; bounded by M01 (H-02, rated as M01). M08 Functions late: Steering correction late; as M11 (H-04, rated as M11). M11 Delayed: Control latency beyond specification; the vehicle overshoots its path in curves and turns (H-04). M12 Inverse function: Acceleration where braking is commanded (sign error) (H-01). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Steering oscillates; the vehicle weaves out of its lane (H-04). M14 Uneven: Steering asymmetric left and right; the excess side leaves the lane as in M13 (H-04, rated as M13).
svg.text: F-07 Follow the planned trajectory: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-07): the 11 safety-related guide words, 6 rated and 5 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
